scope: Incident detail visual proposal only; no application runtime implementation
approval: pending user review; approved login-v2 and home-v1/hero-v2 preserved

style.desktop_content: light background, compact104px technological incident banner, same typography and controls as approved home
style.workflow: four ordered numbered two-part blocks with horizontal arrows; vertical arrows on mobile; flow description above and task with button below
style.mobile: full-width vertical workflow cards, collapsible sections and navigation drawer; no timeline redesign
style.sections: all source sections kept; added anchors only for previously unnamed owner and consequences panels

demo.data: fictional and embedded in incident.js; fixtures.json is the canonical renderer data
demo.backend_actions: never executed; no false success or automatic completion
demo.global_switch: reversible superuser-only demo, preview explicitly ON; future server global setting starts OFF for every tenant
demo.tenant_membership: Superuser demo can select default, laboratorio, defaults; other demo roles only default; membership fixture, not a product rule

workflow_contract.lower: Clickable task type description, action label description/name, configured condition/deadline/document hints
workflow_contract.arrows: Only ordered workflows; desktop horizontal, mobile vertical visual preservation
activation_priority: section_target: open section with redirect/action label/template context
requires_notification and not notification_done: missing documents redirects to forms/documents or ready opens notification preview
else: open action form and preselect action label
specific_blocking: global_check action cannot be recorded until prior steps complete
required notification task cannot be manually recorded before notification action
closure blocked if missing required steps produce procedural warnings
generation blocked if mapped required incident fields missing
notification sender validates recipients, incident-owned selected documents, required document selection
builtin username admin cannot send notifications; can explicitly confirm without send via separate confirmed mode
workflow_contract.completion: Action counts match logical label kind/value with ID fallback; repeated tasks consume distinct action counts
workflow_contract.deadlines: Hours from first initial-information action; not a universally assumed legal deadline
workflow_contract.obsolete: No new assignment/clone; existing incident with unchanged workflow remains operable

access_contract.tenant_scope: Active tenant always scopes incident detail, including superuser; legacy null tenant available via existing compatibility rules
access_contract.operator: Own incidents only, no write through can_write
access_contract.defaults: Tenants Default is configuration/catalogue-only, no operational incidents

behavior_demonstrated: open and close complete role-aware navigation including mobile drawer with focus management
activate real workflow task destinations with source priority
first incomplete marker; configured-only deadline, deterministic sample time
open action form with preselected logical action label
route incomplete notification to required template; ready notification to separate preview and confirmation
show document-generation preview and confirmation; missing mapped fields keep generation blocked
block closure and conclusion while sample required warnings remain
document modes local/both/alfresco, tag editing, local/remote download and separate delete access points
Alfresco sync described as remote read-only status check
general and action/reminder forms with local-only commands
role/tenant/capability checks also inside command handlers, not solely presentation
integration_constraints: all runtime endpoint names and field names mapped in feature-map.json; endpoint access placeholders do not substitute backend permission checks
retain CSRF validation, tenant scoping, validation, safe file handling, storage transactions and configured data semantics
category order participates in workflow selection; IDs must remain tenant-specific; do not replace IDs with visible strings in production
do not automatically label task complete after click, PDF preview, upload or notification preview
only configured global_check blocks a later action; no generic sequential lock
an obsolete workflow cannot be newly assigned/imported/cloned; existing incident remains operable
source runtime remains unchanged until separate approval
limitations: native design boards are not browser screenshots
no browser or runtime/backend test is claimed
representative field/modal examples retain access points; they are not full implementations of destination pages
classification editing is keyboard/touch mock with order controls; drag-and-drop integration is mapped but not implemented here
PDF/content generation, upload, notification delivery and persistent setting changes are not performed
multi-template generation and configuration-dependent form schemas remain actual application behavior; mock displays one representative preview
review API is not authentication or an application privilege switch
